name: iter-browser
description: Iter agent embedded in its own Chromium shell (Electron) — full CDP access, no extension required.

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Iter Browser uses the camera only when you or Iter open a device-capture tab to take a photo.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Iter Browser uses the microphone only when you or Iter open a device-capture tab to record audio.
